Evidence-axis diagnostic (Stage-0 SS9.3)

Source: R/diagnostics.R
evidence_axis.Rd

Per-lens log marginal likelihood (model evidence) via bridge sampling (Meng & Wong 1996; Gronau et al. 2017), as a Bayes-factor cross-check on the battery. This axis has role = "diagnostic": it is a scalar per lens and never enters stacking (the synthesis assembly excludes diagnostic-role output). The estimate is prior-conditional — it is computed under koine's canonical reference prior (coefficients N(0, beta_prior_sd); Gaussian dispersion via a log-sigma N(0, log_sigma_prior_sd) prior), and Bayes factors are sensitive to that prior, so the result is flagged accordingly. Lenses that fit an alternative model structure (a different likelihood, e.g. robust-t) are excluded from the cross-check: their evidence is not comparable on the shared prior.

Usage

evidence_axis(
  fb_fits,
  pass,
  beta_prior_sd = 5,
  log_sigma_prior_sd = 2,
  log_tau_prior_sd = 2
)

Arguments

fb_fits

A list of contributed koine_fb_fit objects.

pass

The originating koine_pass.

beta_prior_sd

Prior SD on the coefficients (default 5, matching the lenses' weakly-informative default).

log_sigma_prior_sd

Prior SD on log-sigma for Gaussian families (default 2).

log_tau_prior_sd

Prior SD on log-tau for mixed-model passes (default 2, matching the RE lenses' weakly-informative default).

Value

A list with available (logical), prior_conditional (always TRUE), and, when available, evidence (a data frame of lens_id, log_ml, log_ml_se) plus note. role is documented as "diagnostic".

Details

Requires the suggested bridgesampling package; absent it, returns a structured unavailable record rather than failing (I1).

Examples

# \donttest{
set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(y = rnorm(40), x = rnorm(40))
pass <- koine_pass(y ~ x, d, gaussian())
fit <- fit_dram(pass, n_iter = 800L, n_burn = 400L, n_chains = 2L)
evidence_axis(list(fit), pass)$evidence
#>   lens_id    log_ml    log_ml_se
#> 1    dram -60.36968 0.0001461722
# }
